description: Risk + protection assessment for an ASIN or brand. Returns composite risk score (0-100), recent MAP violation events (≤10, each with the offending ASIN's product brand, title, price or price range and fulfillment FBA/FBM/Amazon), unauthorized seller list (≤10), and 1-3 recommended actions. Use for 'flag risk events on my brand' or 'is this ASIN risky?' style prompts.

days.description: Lookback window for MAP events. Default 30.

kind_in.description: Comma-separated flagged-event kinds to keep (e.g. map_violations,amazon_dominated).

marketplace_id.description: 1 = Amazon UK, 2 = Amazon US (default), 4 = Amazon CA, 5 = Amazon AU, 6 = Amazon DE, 7 = Amazon JP, 8 = Amazon IT, 9 = Amazon FR, 10 = Amazon ES, 11 = Amazon MX, 12 = Amazon BR

name: risk_assessment
